elements.element: Vendor (Licensor) duty to defend Customer and affiliates
elements.evidence: "Licensor shall defend and indemnify Licensee and its affiliates"

elements.element: Indemnity covers third-party claims alleging services/deliverables infringe IP
elements.evidence: "an allegation that the Licensed Technology, the Documentation or any other materials or services supplied by Licensor infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right"

elements.element: Indemnity covers Vendor's breach of law
Indemnity covers data breach caused by Vendor
elements.evidence: "(iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Licensee's data caused by Licensor"

elements.element: Indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence/wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "(iv) Licensor's gross negligence or willful misconduct"
"shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the claim"
"the indemnifying party shall have control of the defense"
"the indemnified party shall provide reasonable cooperation"

elements.element: Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content
elements.evidence: "(i) content or data provided by Licensee for use with the Licensed Technology"

elements.element: Customer indemnity limited to Customer's breach of law
elements.evidence: "(iii) the breach by the License of any applicable law under this Agreement" and "(ii) ... conduct of Licensee's business ... in breach of applicable law"

elements.element: Vendor IP indemnity with usual exclusions (Customer modifications, combinations, specifications)
elements.evidence: No exclusions appear in the inserted Licensor indemnity paragraph

elements.element: Fallback infringement remedies (procure, modify, replace, refund)
elements.evidence: Inserted paragraph contains only defend/indemnify and procedure, no remedy ladder

elements.element: Vendor indemnity subject to super-cap of 3× annual fees
elements.evidence: "The exclusions and limitations of liability in Article XIII do not apply to Licensor's obligations under this paragraph." — carve-out, no 3× super-cap

reasons: All preferred atomic elements are present: two-way narrowing of the Licensee indemnity to Licensee content/data and breach of applicable law, plus a new Licensor defend-and-indemnify covering IP infringement, breach of law, Licensor-caused data incidents and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, with notice, control and cooperation.

The carve-out from Article XIII is necessary rather than extra, because Article XIII expressly excludes Licensor liability for infringement claims and would otherwise nullify the new indemnity; no fallback remedies, exclusions or super-cap were imported.
Fallback elements (usual exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, 3× annual fees super-cap) are absent, but the drafter targeted preferred and the two levels are not combined.
Untouched sentences and the remainder of Articles XII and XIII remain effective; no undefined terms or dangling mechanics introduced (Licensed Technology and Documentation are defined).
